# Shebi Enterprises

> Mumbai cladding, curtain wall and glazing contractor since 2005. Stone wet/dry cladding, ACP, structural glass, spider glazing, skylights, fabrication and facade maintenance.

## Company facts
- Legal / brand name: Shebi Enterprises
- Founded: 2005
- Founder: Jerald Francis

- Notable clients include: Lodha, Oberoi, Piramal, ITC, Reliance, L&T and other developers across India
